limitations.summary: However, this study has some limitations: (1) Experiments focused on single-target scenarios, neglecting multi-target or group detection contexts; (2) Adv-Camou is designed for long-wave infrared (8-14 μm) and lacks cross-band synergy with visible or mid-wave infrared (3-5 μm) spectra.
